promise.heading: A package manager for agent skills and instructions.
promise.secondary: One command installs skills and writes the shared sections of AGENTS.md for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode, locks every version, reports drift and renders the same instructions for ChatGPT.
promise.description: A package manager for the skills and instructions of Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and ChatGPT.

repositories.name: cli
repositories.summary: The `agents` command: add skills and instructions from local paths, Git repositories or well-known indexes, write them for each agent, restore them from the lock and watch sources for changes.

repositories.name: core
repositories.summary: Swift library behind `agents` and `skill`: sources, declaration, lock, cache, skills and instructions.
